name: aeon
title_zh: Aeon 实例管家：从零搭起、挑技能、改调度、修哑火
tagline_zh: 从零搭 Aeon 实例、挑技能、改调度、修不触发的技能，还能翻旧聊天记录挖出重复活儿，一键自动化。
tagline_en: Spin up Aeon, pick skills, reschedule runs, fix misfires, and mine old Claude chats for recurring work worth.
desc_en: Set up and run an Aeon agent instance — get started from scratch, pick which skills to turn on or install more from packs, reschedule or change what runs, edit what an existing skill does, fix a skill that isn't firing, set the STRATEGY.md north star and soul/ voice, turn a Claude Code chat into a scheduled Aeon skill, and mine past Claude Code conversations for recurring work worth automating as
why_zh: 不止是配置器——它把「技能没触发」也当一等问题处理，还自带从聊天记录反推自动化机会的挖掘流程。
why_en: It treats misfires as first-class, and mines past chats to surface automation opportunities you didn't know you had.
limit_zh: 只管 Aeon 实例本身的搭建与运维，不写具体技能逻辑；需要已有 Claude Code 聊天记录才能做挖掘。
limit_en: Only manages Aeon setup/ops, not skill logic. Mining needs existing Claude Code chat logs; empty history yields nothing.
title_en: Aeon instance manager: setup, skills, schedules, fixes
